specs.name: CPU
specs.value: Rockchip RK3588J, Quad(4)-core Cortex-A76 (2.0GHz) and Quad(4)-core Cortex-A55 (1.8GHz)

specs.name: GPU
specs.value: ARM Mali-G610 MC4. Up to 8K60 FPS video decoding, up to 8K30 FPS video encoding.

specs.name: NPU
specs.value: Neural network acceleration engine with 6Tops int8, support Int4/8/16/FP16/BF16/TF32.

specs.name: Storage
specs.value: TF Card, Supports up to 128GB SDHC

specs.name: Touch
specs.value: 5-point capacitive touch screen with 1mm tempered glass

specs.name: USB
specs.value: 2 x USB 3.0 HOST, 1 x USB Type-C

specs.name: RTC
specs.value: High accuracy RTC with farad capacitor, can work 1 week after power off (default). High accuracy RTC with lithium coin battery, can work 3 years after power off (optional).

specs.value: default 2 x RS232 (Optional 6 x RS232 at most, include 1 debug port)
